'''Lag windowing''' is a technique that consists of [[window function| windowing]] the [[autocorrelation]] coefficients prior to estimating [[linear prediction]] coefficients (LPC). The windowing in the autocorrelation domain has the same effect as a convolution (smoothing) in the [[power spectrum|power spectral domain]] and helps in stabilizing the result of the [[Levinson-Durbin]] algorithm. The window function is typically a [[Gaussian function]].
